title: Multi-stage build prompts for image search
body:
### Issue Description

I am one of the maintainers of the Strimzi project where we use multi-stage builds and I use podman locally to build images. Everything has been working for years but after one of the latest updates, I am facing an issue with podman and multi-stage build. I have a reproducer in this repo (instead of the more complex Strimzi one): https://github.com/brusdev/container-hierarchy.

By running the `./build.sh` I get the following:

```shell
./build.sh 
[build.sh] Building base image: container-hierarchy/base:latest
STEP 1/3: FROM scratch
STEP 2/3: COPY app/main /main
--> dcb109fcf128
STEP 3/3: ENTRYPOINT ["/main"]
COMMIT container-hierarchy/base:latest
--> fa813e7f1c9c
Successfully tagged localhost/container-hierarchy/base:latest
fa813e7f1c9cc8426fff1dfbde12c0ba3aaa6e6a484646cd3ebb8ccc82f54702
[build.sh] Base image built → container-hierarchy/base:latest
[build.sh] Building app image: container-hierarchy/app:latest
[1/2] STEP 1/1: FROM container-hierarchy/base:latest
? Please select an image: 
  ▸ registry.fedoraproject.org/container-hierarchy/base:latest
    registry.access.redhat.com/container-hierarchy/base:latest
    docker.io/container-hierarchy/base:latest
```

The same happens in our Strimzi project while it has been working without this prompt for ages.

### Steps to reproduce the issue

Steps to reproduce the issue
1. use a Dockerfile with multi-stage builds or clone https://github.com/brusdev/container-hierarchy for simplicity
2. build the Dockerfile


### Describe the results you received

```shell
? Please select an image: 
  ▸ registry.fedoraproject.org/container-hierarchy/base:latest
    registry.access.redhat.com/container-hierarchy/base:latest
    docker.io/container-hierarchy/base:latest
```

### Describe the results you expected

No prompt asking for selecting an image.

comments.body: I am also running into this issue, specifically with multi-stage builds. It seems that Podman's behavior differs significantly between single-stage and multi-stage builds in this scenario, which is inconsistent.

I see the same output from your reproducer on podman 5.8.4 rootless on Fedora 44

I don't know the full details but it looks something like it wants to guarantee the image has the right architecture, but doesn't have manifests locally, so it tries to pull the unqualified `container-hierarchy/base:latest` manifests which could exist in a remote repo.

workarounds I've found are:

1. explicitly set your image names to be `localhost/` prepended, I guess giving the engine knowledge that it's local only
2. set `--pull=never` on the second build command
